name: glassbox
description: Claude Code as a glass box: a pane on the right with the session's hooks to switch off, the active git branches, the files changed in the session and a guard that lights up when another open session is changing the same files, what goes into the context of every request, with stats and tips to keep it lean, the open sessions with the state of their prompt cache, kept warm while a session waits for its agents, and VOX and SYNTH: a selection or Claude's last reply read raw, as plain spoken prose or as a terse summary, and heard in a local Italian voice (Piper)

recordSessions.title: Record sessions
recordSessions.description: Keep every request of the session on disk with the context it carried, the system prompt and the tools, under the sessions folder

sessionsDir.title: Sessions folder
sessionsDir.description: Where the session records go; empty: ~/.claude/glassbox/sessions
